description: Makes pictures in the project's look, as many as asked, from an idea and/or products. Spends the owner's tokens at the price of the picture model they chose. Without confirm: true it only quotes the price; with it, it starts making them. They land in Create for the owner to keep. A picture of a real place, landmark or artwork is made from real photographs of it; when none can be trusted, it waits in Create for a photo from the owner instead of being invented. The owner is asked once per place, and Marsell looks again every ten minutes for free: once a photo of it arrives (get_upload_link, kind picture, captioned with the place), the waiting pictures are made from it. The business's own characters and places (get_brand lists them) are made from their own pictures, in the look the idea calls for, when the idea has them in it.

confirm.description: true to spend the tokens and make them; otherwise a quote.

count.description: How many pictures, 1 or more; 2 when left out. The quote grows with it.

idea.description: What the pictures show, in a sentence.

product_ids.description: Products to feature, by their ids in get_brand's products.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
